reference_previous_used_subjects: S001-S024 were involved in earlier EEG source/decoder studies; none of S025-S028 has been read before this registration
source_reading: use existing frozen event_windows, band_features, get_original_edf; 160Hz, C3/C4, T1/T2, crop 0.5–2.5s, first 2/3 train last 1/3 test, original whole-record 1–30Hz 4th order Butterworth sosfiltfilt
counterfactual: sign invert raw EEG only for ALL heldout test-event crops, then refilter full original run to obtain altered training log-bandpower, keeping original training T1/T2 event labels and evaluating both fit models on SAME clean original test features
new_logistic_fit: before adding regularized bias, freeze standardization mean/std to original CLEAN training feature means/std (zeros replace with one). Use exact custom lambda=.5 everywhere penalizing augmented bias, match altered/clean models exactly; do not reuse original sklearn LogisticRegression results as certified.
certificate: norm of perturbed training objective gradient at clean fitted theta divided by lambda upper bounds norm distance to perturbed mathematical optimum by strong monotonicity. Test logit margin must EXCEED norm(original clean heldout augmented feature) times parameter radius to certify class invariance. Any uncertified case ABSTAINS (not auto-label flipped).
accuracy_endpoint: descriptive reference model heldout accuracy, not claimed gain
primary_metrics: per person count of clean heldout trials with sound predicted-label invariance certificates
per person count of empirically flipped predictions after whole-record test-source-only sign flip
fraction of original test trials with nonvacuous certificate
max actual parameter shift vs theoretical bound
failure_policy: fail closed if any EDF missing, MNE event imbalance, optimizer numerical residual >1e-7, data mismatch, unexpected wrong cell count, certificate false positive; never exclude samples based on outcome
no_priority_claims: standard strong-convex optimality bounds are prior art
